title: Shipping Insurance
alt: A parcel on a dashed route that passes a coverage shield on its way to a home, turning teal.
message: Your parcel is covered from pickup to the customer's door.
active: the route draws on and the parcel, now past the shield, turns from kraft to teal
meaning: the shipment is covered all the way to the door

title: Solutions
alt: A route from a parcel to a home with three check rings along it, each checked.
message: Risk is checked before, during and after delivery.
active: the route draws and the three rings gain their checks in order, 34 ms apart
meaning: each stage of delivery has its own check

title: Partners
alt: A storefront and a laptop linked by dashed routes to one teal policy plate.
message: The coverage joins the platforms you already ship with.
active: routes draw from the storefront and the laptop into the plate, which fills teal
meaning: your platforms connect to one coverage

title: Resources
alt: A row of binders of rising height, the teal one pulled forward.
message: Everything a shipper needs to know is on one shelf.
active: the teal binder slides forward out of the row
meaning: the right resource is ready to hand

title: About
alt: A teal shield on a policy plate, with news sheets and a mailbox beside it.
message: A UPS Capital company stands behind every policy.
active: the plate fills teal under the shield and the shield gets its check
meaning: the company stands behind the policy

title: Multi-Carrier Shipments
alt: Four parcels with different carrier stripes stand on one teal policy plate.
message: One policy covers you whichever carrier you use.
active: the plate fills teal under all four parcels at once

title: UPS Shipments
alt: A parcel with a UPS brown-and-gold band in front of a teal shield with a check.
message: Your UPS parcels get coverage built for UPS.
active: the shield behind the UPS parcel gains its check

title: Special Commodities
alt: A blue item rising out of an open kraft box over a teal plate.
message: What is unusual inside the box is covered too.
active: the blue item rises out of the open box as the plate under it fills teal

title: Select My Coverage
alt: A parcel settling onto the middle one of three plates, which turns teal.
message: A few answers find the coverage that fits your shipments.
active: the parcel settles onto the middle plate, which turns teal

title: Get a Quote
alt: A group of parcels beside a teal coin stack that grows with it.
message: Your price follows your shipping volume.
active: one parcel joins the group and the stack grows one coin

title: CommerceShield
alt: A parcel whose coral risk ring turns into a teal check ring.
message: A risky order is flagged and screened before it costs you.
active: the coral ring above the parcel resolves into a teal check ring
meaning: the risky order is screened and protected

title: DeliveryDefense
alt: A teal pin landing on a puck at a home's door, a ring spreading.
message: Know the address is a safe drop before the parcel leaves.
active: the pin drops onto the puck at the door and a ring spreads once

title: Delivery Orchestration
alt: A parcel at a fork; the safer branch to the home is drawn in teal.
message: Send each parcel by the lower-risk delivery option.
active: at the fork, the safer branch draws teal to the home

title: InsureShield® Shipping Insurance
alt: A parcel turning teal in front of a coverage shield, grey parcels behind.
message: Your parcels are covered; others are on their own.
active: the front parcel turns from kraft to teal in front of the shield

title: Connect with a Partner
alt: A teal block seating into a slot in a grey platform block.
message: Coverage plugs into the platform you already use.
active: the teal block slides down and seats into the grey block
meaning: coverage is connected inside the platform

title: Become a Partner
alt: A storefront with a teal awning; a parcel leaves its door on a teal route.
message: Your customers' parcels leave your business covered.
active: the awning fills teal and a route draws out from the door under the parcel

title: Insights
alt: Bars of stacked parcels on a sheet, the tallest topped in teal.
message: Real numbers on shipping risk, built from parcels.
active: the parcel bars stack up one parcel at a time, the last in teal

title: Whitepapers & Guides
alt: A stack of sheets with a teal route drawn across the top one.
message: Guides map the way from risk to coverage.
active: a dashed teal route draws across the top sheet

title: Customer Stories
alt: A damaged parcel with a coral mark linked by a teal route to a coin stack.
message: Businesses that had a loss got paid back fast.
active: the route draws from the coral parcel and the coin stack rises
meaning: the loss is paid back quickly

title: Help & Support
alt: A document with a ring that gains a teal check.
message: Questions about coverage, billing and claims get answered.
active: the ring on the document gains its teal check

title: Announcements
alt: A teal sheet landing on top of a stack of sheets.
message: Something new has arrived from InsureShield.
active: a teal sheet slides down onto the top of the stack

title: In The News
alt: A printed sheet with column rules and a teal shield stamped on it.
message: UPS Capital, as covered by the press.
active: a small shield stamps down onto the printed sheet

title: Product Availability
alt: Teal pins landed on a row of three pucks.
message: See the places where coverage is offered.
active: pins drop onto the pucks one after another

title: Contact Us
alt: A teal mailbox on a post with its flag raised.
message: Your message reaches our team.
active: the mailbox flag raises
meaning: a message is waiting for our team
